hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: A feature-rich multi-layout tech demo with clean card UI and animated transitions between 7 layouts, but no title or typographic hierarchy, schemeTableau10 colors without custom curation, and the bottom of the circle pack is cropped in the rendered viewport.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Area encoding is correct throughout — d3.pack() handles circle sizing, force layout uses scaleSqrt for radii, sunburst uses scaleSqrt for radial scale — all domains are data-driven via root.count()/root.value, key functions present in node joins, and no bar/area baseline violations or dual-axis deception.
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: Bundling slider fires unthrottled drawBundleLinks() on every input event (300 paths, no RAF/dirty-flag); transitionTo() lacks an explicit .interrupt() before starting a new 1200ms tween (mitigated by source-position capture but not guaranteed safe); force-drag has no touch-event filter, risking double-trigger on mobile.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: Circle pack view is readable — 6–9 Tableau10 colors separate cleanly, nested circles encode hierarchy intuitively, and 300 bundle links at 0.15 opacity stay subordinate; main unassessable risk is 200-node simultaneous shape-morphing animation across 7 layout transitions, which could produce high perceptual churn in motion.
